rows.label: tlk70000001_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Seeing everyone work so hard reminds
me of the old days, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Morumo wasn't trusted by everyone from
the start, mo. I had no choice but to
run around desperately every day, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I made lots of mistakes, mo. I caused
plenty of trouble, mo. But those
experiences taught me something, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Whether you fail or succeed, it
doesn't end there, mo. What matters is
to keep going, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_03_msg0005
rows.name:
So all of you... try lots of different
things, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000001_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Alst is huge and you only live once,
mo. It'd be a waste not to make the
most of it, mo!!
